description: Stations de recharge électrique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. This dataset lists the electric charging stations on the territory of the city of Saint-Paul-lès-Dax.It consists of a list of geo-located points on OpenStreetMap accompanied by information such as charging time, accessibility, number of stations, bollard photo, etc. This data comes from OpenStreetMap. Coverage: Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. The portal shows the English title as "Electric charging stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. Its keywords include electromobilite, recharge, borne, electrique, vehicule, station. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF, CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
